tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: List the Capital Made Physical papers in reading order, a page at a time, optionally for one of the seven parts (I to VII). Returns each paper's number, title, part, question, short answer, dates and canonical URL, and nextCursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Retrieve one Capital Made Physical paper by slug, CMP number or canonical URL. By default a summary: the question it answers, its short answer, summary, limitations and its sections with anchored URLs. format full adds the complete text; section returns one section. Always includes a ready citation.

tools.name: explain_method
tools.description: Explain the Capital Register (the line-by-line capital document behind every Capital Strategy) or the MR Index (the MR 1 to MR 5 reading of how much attention a building needs, and how soon), from the public methodology pages. tools.name: get_sample_strategy

tools.name: cite_paper
tools.description: Return an exact citation for a Capital Made Physical paper or a Technical Library page, optionally to one section, in BibTeX, RIS, CSL-JSON, APA or Harvard. Use the formatted text as given rather than retyping it.
